authoritative: Source: the Secretary of State's official 1998 governor returns by county, whose county rows add up to each candidate's printed state total; they replace Algara and Amlani's county rows.
title: November 3, 1998 general election, governor, by county

pages.hint: One row per Tennessee county with one column per candidate across the page; the column headers are the candidate numbers 1 to 7 and Write-In's, so label each column with the candidate's printed name from the key at the top of the page (candidate 1 is John Jay Hooker, 2 Don Sundquist, 3 Lonnie L. Creech, 4 Irwin W. Gibbs, 5 George Alexander Hamilton, Sr, 6 Thomas E. Smith II, 7 Karl Smithson) and label the last column Write-Ins. Read the votes only. Include the STATE TOTAL row where it appears.
